$schema.description: Declares an inline SimplifiedSchema mapping, referenced schema file, or root union for this document. Raw JSON Schema is supported through referenced files only. Document schemas override baseline properties on conflict.

title.description: Human-readable document title. Used by markdown_title(), reports, diagnostics, and downstream tools that need a display name.

description.description: Human-readable document summary. Used by reports and diagnostics when identifying a document.

draft.description: Author-controlled draft marker. Darkmatter does not use this for compose control but commonly ignores it during hash workflows.

last_updated.description: Managed content-change date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Hash save and downstream tools may update it when content changes.

anyOf.description: Interval from the default date property
Content change of a file, fingerprint held in a property

metadata.description: Arbitrary author metadata. Darkmatter preserves it and leaves interpretation to downstream tools.

anyOf.description: Stored shorthand hash. The simple form is '<frontmatter>-<body>' with 16 hexadecimal characters per segment.

kind.description: Hash resolution stored in longhand form.

value.description: Stored hash payload. A string is used for fm, body, simple, and structured hashes; detailed hashes use a nested object.

ignored.description: Extra frontmatter keys ignored during hash computation. The managed hash key and last_updated are always ignored and should not be listed.

anyOf.description: Pad table cells so columns line up (the default).
Unwrap, then re-wrap prose to this display width.
false: never re-wrap; true: re-wrap to 120.
Join single line breaks inside paragraphs.
Four spaces per nested-list level (the default).
Renumber ordered lists that are neither uniform nor sequential (the default).
Ensure one blank line before and after every list (the default).
Leave blank lines around lists as authored.

list-item-padding.description: Blank lines between sibling items of the same list.

list-interior-padding.description: Blank lines between an item's first line and the blocks nested inside it.

anyOf.description: Language added to unlabeled code fences.

change.description: Change metadata used by Darkmatter workflows. The v1 baseline accepts all shapes until the public change contract is finalized.

replace.description: Literal text replacement map applied during compose. Keys are source strings and values are replacement strings.

cwd.description: Absolute launch directory captured when the composition request began, or null when ambient capture failed.

self.description: Absolute canonical native path of the root document, or null for URL and in-memory roots.

last_updated.description: Filesystem modification time of the root document, or null when unavailable or for URL and in-memory roots.

hash.description: The root document's '<frontmatter>-<body>' xxHash of its source as loaded, matching `md hash`, or null for URL and in-memory roots.

id.description: xxHash identifying this execution of the root document: its source, ctx.timestamp_ms, host name, repository name, and a per-execution random nonce.

sid.description: Full hexadecimal BLAKE3 digest of the same inputs as ctx.id. A cryptographic digest, not a secret.

now.description: Local date and time in ISO-8601 format.

now_utc.description: UTC date and time in ISO-8601 format.

yesterday.description: Local date for yesterday in ISO-8601 format.

yesterday_utc.description: UTC date for yesterday in ISO-8601 format.

tomorrow.description: Local date for tomorrow in ISO-8601 format.

tomorrow_utc.description: UTC date for tomorrow in ISO-8601 format.

day.description: Full day of week name, local time.

day_utc.description: Full day of week name, UTC.

day_abbr.description: Abbreviated day of week name, local time.

day_abbr_utc.description: Abbreviated day of week name, UTC.

month.description: Current month as a zero-padded number, local time.

month_name_abbr.description: Abbreviated current month name, local time.

day_of_month_suffixed.description: Current day of month with ordinal suffix.

time.description: Local time in 12-hour format with AM/PM.

time_utc.description: UTC time in 12-hour format with AM/PM.

timezone.description: Local timezone abbreviation, or null when unavailable.

timezone_iana.description: Local IANA timezone name, or null when unavailable.

start_of_week_sun.description: Start of the current Sunday-based week, local time.

end_of_week_sun.description: End of the current Sunday-based week, local time.

start_of_week_mon.description: Start of the current Monday-based week, local time.

end_of_week_mon.description: End of the current Monday-based week, local time.

start_of_week_sun_utc.description: Start of the current Sunday-based week, UTC.

end_of_week_sun_utc.description: End of the current Sunday-based week, UTC.

start_of_week_mon_utc.description: Start of the current Monday-based week, UTC.

end_of_week_mon_utc.description: End of the current Monday-based week, UTC.

repo.description: Repository name from the preferred remote URL, or null when unavailable.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository root path, or null when unavailable.

branch.description: Current local Git branch name, or null outside a repository or at detached HEAD.

worktree.description: Current linked Git worktree name, or null in the main worktree or outside a repository.

recent_commits.description: Recent commits of the captured repository, newest first. Each element is one commit rendered exactly as `sniff repo recent-commits --plain` renders it (a multi-line block). `ctx.recent_commits` holds the last 10, captured at the start of execution; `recent_commits(count)` returns the newest `count`, evaluated at call time. Empty outside a repository.

is_monorepo.description: Whether the current repository is a monorepo.

package_root.description: Absolute current package root path, or null when unavailable.

package_area_root.description: Absolute current package area root path, or null when unavailable.

packages.description: Package names, or null when unavailable.

package_areas.description: Package area names, or null when unavailable.

current_package.description: Current package name, or null when unavailable.

current_package_area.description: Current package area, or null when unavailable.

depends_on.description: Workspace-internal package dependencies. Each item is an object with a `package` (string) field and a `dependencies` (string[]) field listing the packages it depends on.

used_by.description: Workspace-internal package reverse dependencies. Each item is an object with a `package` (string) field and a `users` (string[]) field listing the packages that depend on it.

merge_conflicts.description: Repository-relative paths currently in an unresolved Git index state.

current_package_has_staged_files.description: Whether the current package has staged files.

current_package_area_has_staged_files.description: Whether the current package area has staged files.

current_package_has_dirty_files.description: Whether the current package has dirty files.

current_package_area_has_dirty_files.description: Whether the current package area has dirty files.

programming_languages_in_repo.description: Programming languages in the repository, or null when unavailable.

programming_language.description: Context-sensitive primary programming language, or null when unavailable.

package_manager.description: Context-sensitive package manager, or null when unavailable.

docs_drift.description: Docs at risk of drift from source changes.

docs_skill.description: Repo-relative path to the best matching skill file, or null when unavailable.

os.description: Operating system name, or null when unavailable.

hostname.description: Host name reported by the operating system, or null when unavailable.

os_distro.description: Linux distribution name, empty on macOS and Windows.

os_package_manager.description: Primary system package manager, or null when unavailable.

memory_total.description: Total system memory in bytes, or null when unavailable.

memory_used.description: Percentage of memory currently used, or null when unavailable.

memory_avail.description: Available system memory in bytes, or null when unavailable.

cpu_cores.description: Number of logical CPU cores, or null when unavailable.

cpu_arch.description: CPU architecture, or null when unavailable.

gpu.description: GPU device names, or null when unavailable.

tailnet.description: Whether any host interface has an address in the CGNAT range 100.64.0.0/10 (Tailscale). Other VPNs and CGNAT ISPs using that range also report true.

gateway.description: Primary IPv4 gateway address, or null without a default route or when the default route has no gateway address.

gateway_v6.description: Primary IPv6 gateway address, with a %scope suffix for link-local gateways, or null without a default route or when the default route has no gateway address.

agent.description: The agentic CLI provider being used in the current session.

model.description: Active model identifier, trimmed from the MODEL env var; defaults to "default".

ignore_invalid.description: Allows invalid transclusion references to be left in place as warnings instead of aborting composition.

interpolate_code_blocks.description: Enables interpolation inside fenced code blocks. Disabled by default so code examples stay literal.
